scope: Television only through S3E10 Troy, released 4 September 2026. No novel events, future season-four explanations, ancestry claims or unreleased lore. This is a sequel to the channel's first broad Silo episode, not the same overview with shuffled paragraphs.
method: Opened public plot references, official production/Databank sources and creator/cast interviews; primary fictional works are episode/book locators. Original commentary; no copied dialogue. Not a claim to have watched every episode or newly read each whole novel.

sources.fact: The third season ran July 3 to September 4, 2026 and follows Juliette's memory loss alongside Helen and Daniel in the Before Times.
The finale of season one connects better tape, Supply and repeating visor birds with Juliette's survival and recognition of a display.
Hanna's magnifying device, the Flamekeepers, reproductive suppression and mirror cameras show several distinct ways of limiting inquiry.
sources.note: Refreshed with original episode-source file; keep testimony attributed.

sources.fact: The Pez toy in the earlier investigation is linked to Daniel's gift to Helen by the season-two final Before Times scene.
Camille uses false footage and suppressants while Juliette has memory loss; restored public hero imagery is managed.

The founders describe a human seed-bank plan; Jimmy's mother disabled the Safeguard. Billings learns Ed Harwood built an illegal elevator used to steal from Critical Supply. This is unauthorized infrastructure, not proof of an official privilege for rulers.
Pregnant Helen and Daniel are separated into S18 and S1, with an explosion at the unveiling in the Before Times story.
Daniel is Troy; Charlotte is Susan; Silo 1 people operate the Algorithm. Failed internal Safeguard and external action against S17 are different mechanisms. Memories of Helen persist.
The drive George and Allison investigate carries the identifier eighteen; Bernard searches for it in S1E9. Its full origin is not thereby solved.
